items.title: 啾啾妹 CHUCHUMEI

cues.zh: 大家都知道
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 zhi1 dao4

cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 jia4 dao4 xiang1 gang3 de5 tai2 wan1 xi2 fu4

cues.zh: 会讲一两句广东话
cues.pinyin: hui4 jiang3 yi1 liang3 ju4 guang3 dong1 hua4
cues.en: being able to speak a little Cantonese

cues.zh: 还是很正常的吧
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 hen3 zheng4 chang2 de5 ba5
cues.en: is pretty normal, right?

cues.zh: 虽然不是很流利
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 bu2 shi4 hen3 liu2 li4
cues.en: I'm not very fluent,

cues.zh: 但是日常对话是OK的哦
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ri4 chang2 dui4 hua4 shi4 de5 o2
cues.en: but everyday conversation is fine.

cues.zh: 很多baby咨询我怎么学广东话
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 zi1 xun2 wo3 zen3 me5 xue2 guang3 dong1 hua4
cues.en: Many of you ask how I learned Cantonese.

cues.zh: 今天我就来分享
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 lai2 fen1 xiang3
cues.en: Today I'll share

cues.zh: 我学广东话的神秘历程
cues.pinyin: wo3 xue2 guang3 dong1 hua4 de5 shen2 mi4 li4 cheng2
cues.en: my journey learning Cantonese.

items.title: 啾啾妹 CHUCHUMEI
items.title_zh: 慢慢练习就会进步

cues.zh: 以上就是我学习广东话的经验
cues.pinyin: yi3 shang4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 xue2 xi2 guang3 dong1 hua4 de5 jing1 yan4
cues.en: That's my experience learning Cantonese.

cues.zh: 但语言这种东西
cues.pinyin: dan4 yu3 yan2 zhe4 zhong3 dong1 xi1
cues.en: But when it comes to language,

cues.zh: 每个人吸收力不同
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 xi1 shou1 li4 bu4 tong2
cues.en: everyone learns at a different pace.

cues.zh: 所以也不用太着急啦
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ye3 bu4 yong4 tai4 zhao2 ji2 la5
cues.en: So there's no need to rush.

cues.zh: 一天一天慢慢练习
cues.pinyin: yi1 tian1 yi1 tian1 man4 man4 lian4 xi2
cues.en: Practise a little every day.

cues.zh: 会在不知不觉中进步的
cues.pinyin: hui4 zai4 bu4 zhi1 bu4 jue2 zhong1 jin4 bu4 de5
cues.en: You'll improve without even noticing.

cues.zh: 像我就超想学好英文的
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 jiu4 chao1 xiang3 xue2 hao3 ying1 wen2 de5
cues.en: I really want to improve my English.

cues.zh: 从国小开始学英文
cues.pinyin: cong2 guo2 xiao3 kai1 shi3 xue2 ying1 wen2
cues.en: I started learning English in primary school.

cues.zh: 至今也学了十年了吧
cues.pinyin: zhi4 jin1 ye3 xue2 le5 shi2 nian2 le5 ba5
cues.en: It's been about ten years now.

cues.zh: 那你们留言分享学英文的妙招
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 men5 liu2 yan2 fen1 xiang3 xue2 ying1 wen2 de5 miao4 zhao1
cues.en: Share your English-learning tips in the comments.

cues.zh: 给我吧
cues.pinyin: gei3 wo3 ba5
cues.en: I'd love to hear them.

cues.zh: 那今天的影片就到这啰
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 de5 ying3 pian4 jiu4 dao4 zhe4 luo1
cues.en: That's all for today's video.

cues.zh: 我们下次再见拜拜
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 ci4 zai4 jian4 bai4 bai4
cues.en: See you next time. Bye!

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 挑选脆爽的小黄瓜

cues.zh: 大家好我是小高姐
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 xiao3 gao1 jie3
cues.en: Hi, I'm Xiaogaojie.

cues.zh: 今天我们来做拍黄瓜
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 pai1 huang2 gua1
cues.en: Today we're making smashed cucumber.

cues.zh: 我用的是这种小黄瓜
cues.pinyin: wo3 yong4 de5 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 xiao3 huang2 gua1
cues.en: I'm using these small cucumbers.

cues.zh: 它的皮儿比较薄个头也小
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 pi2 er2 bi3 jiao4 bao2 ge4 tou2 ye3 xiao3
cues.en: They have thin skins and are small.

cues.zh: 里头的黄瓜籽也很小
cues.pinyin: li3 tou5 de5 huang2 gua1 zi3 ye3 hen3 xiao3
cues.en: The seeds inside are small too.

cues.zh: 而且口感比较脆
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 kou3 gan3 bi3 jiao4 cui4
cues.en: And they have a crisp texture.

cues.zh: 洗干净去掉两头
cues.pinyin: xi3 gan1 jing4 qu4 diao4 liang3 tou2
cues.en: Wash them and trim both ends.

cues.zh: 直接拍
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 pai1
cues.en: Then smash them.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 拍黄瓜的小技巧

cues.zh: 但是呢你不要把它拍到完全断开
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ne5 ni3 bu2 yao4 ba3 ta1 pai1 dao4 wan2 quan2 duan4 kai1
cues.en: Don't smash it completely apart.

cues.zh: 然后切长菱形
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 qie4 zhang3 ling2 xing2
cues.en: Then cut it into long diamond shapes.

cues.zh: 我不把它拍到断开
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 ba3 ta1 pai1 dao4 duan4 kai1
cues.en: I don't smash it all the way through,

cues.zh: 切出来的黄瓜条形状完整
cues.pinyin: qie4 chu1 lai2 de5 huang2 gua1 tiao2 xing2 zhuang4 wan2 zheng3
cues.en: so the cut pieces keep their shape.

cues.zh: 也不会有很多黄瓜的小碎块
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu2 hui4 you3 hen3 duo1 huang2 gua1 de5 xiao3 sui4 kuai4
cues.en: And there aren't lots of little bits.

cues.zh: 拍散的黄瓜心儿呢
cues.pinyin: pai1 san4 de5 huang2 gua1 xin1 er2 ne5
cues.en: The smashed cucumber center

cues.zh: 还可以吸收很多调料的汁水
cues.pinyin: hai2 ke3 yi3 xi1 shou1 hen3 duo1 tiao2 liao4 de5 zhi1 shui3
cues.en: can soak up plenty of dressing.

cues.zh: 放盐先腌几分钟入味儿
cues.pinyin: fang4 yan2 xian1 yan1 ji3 fen1 zhong1 ru4 wei4 er5
cues.en: Add salt and let it season for a few minutes.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 黄瓜皮和籽怎么处理

cues.zh: 如果你买的黄瓜皮比较厚呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 mai3 de5 huang2 gua1 pi2 bi3 jiao4 hou4 ne5
cues.en: If your cucumber has thick skin,

cues.zh: 可以用刮刀刮去一部分皮
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 yong4 gua1 dao1 gua1 qu4 yi1 bu4 fen4 pi2
cues.en: peel some of it off.

cues.zh: 切开看看里面
cues.pinyin: qie4 kai1 kan4 kan4 li3 mian4
cues.en: Cut it open and look inside.

cues.zh: 这个黄瓜的籽儿不算大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 huang2 gua1 de5 zi3 er2 bu4 suan4 da4
cues.en: This cucumber's seeds aren't very big.

cues.zh: 你可以留着
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 liu2 zhe5
cues.en: You can leave them in.

cues.zh: 如果黄瓜籽比较大的话呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 huang2 gua1 zi3 bi3 jiao4 da4 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: If the seeds are large,

cues.zh: 可以像这样刮掉
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 xiang4 zhe4 yang4 gua1 diao4
cues.en: scrape them out like this.

cues.zh: 不过用那样的黄瓜的话
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 yong4 na4 yang4 de5 huang2 gua1 de5 hua4
cues.en: But with that kind of cucumber,

cues.zh: 口感会打折扣
cues.pinyin: kou3 gan3 hui4 da3 zhe2 kou4
cues.en: the texture won't be quite as good.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 为什么要把蒜捣成泥

cues.zh: 捣碎的蒜是成泥状的
cues.pinyin: dao3 sui4 de5 suan4 shi4 cheng2 ni2 zhuang4 de5
cues.en: Crushed garlic becomes a paste.

cues.zh: 它比较容易附着在黄瓜的表面
cues.pinyin: ta1 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4 fu4 zhuo2 zai4 huang2 gua1 de5 biao3 mian4
cues.en: It clings more easily to the cucumber.

cues.zh: 吃到嘴里蒜味会很足
cues.pinyin: chi1 dao4 zui3 li3 suan4 wei4 hui4 hen3 zu2
cues.en: So each bite has plenty of garlic flavor.

cues.zh: 要不然这个菜也叫蒜泥黄瓜
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 zhe4 ge5 cai4 ye3 jiao4 suan4 ni2 huang2 gua1
cues.en: That's why it's also called garlic cucumber.

cues.zh: 如果是用刀把蒜切小颗粒
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi4 yong4 dao1 ba4 suan4 qie4 xiao3 ke1 li4
cues.en: If you chop the garlic into little bits,

cues.zh: 它不容易挂在黄瓜的上面
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 rong2 yi4 gua4 zai4 huang2 gua1 de5 shang4 mian4
cues.en: it doesn't stick to the cucumber as well.

cues.zh: 你吃完黄瓜呢你会发现
cues.pinyin: ni3 chi1 wan2 huang2 gua1 ne5 ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: After eating the cucumber, you'll find

cues.zh: 有一盘子底的小蒜粒
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 pan2 zi5 di3 de5 xiao3 suan4 li4
cues.en: little garlic bits left on the plate.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 调出酸辣开胃的味道

cues.zh: 夏季开胃小菜
cues.pinyin: xia4 ji4 kai1 wei4 xiao3 cai4
cues.en: For an appetizing summer side dish,

cues.zh: 少不了酸和辣的味道
cues.pinyin: shao4 bu4 liao3 suan1 he2 la4 de5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: you need sour and spicy flavors.

cues.zh: 一大勺醋和一勺辣椒油
cues.pinyin: yi1 da4 shao2 cu4 he2 yi1 shao2 la4 jiao1 you2
cues.en: A tablespoon of vinegar and a spoon of chili oil.

cues.zh: 加一点糖来平衡它们的味道
cues.pinyin: jia1 yi4 dian3 tang2 lai2 ping2 heng2 ta1 men5 de5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: Add a little sugar to balance the flavors.

cues.zh: 生抽增加它的鲜味
cues.pinyin: sheng1 chou1 zeng1 jia1 ta1 de5 xian1 wei4
cues.en: Light soy sauce adds savoriness.

cues.zh: 点一点香油增加它的香味儿
cues.pinyin: dian3 yi4 dian3 xiang1 you2 zeng1 jia1 ta1 de5 xiang1 wei4 er2
cues.en: A little sesame oil adds aroma.

items.title: History Odyssey
items.title_zh: 一口氣看完中華五千年歷史：從三皇五帝到清朝滅亡！誰是最強王朝？｜歷史之旅

cues.zh: 今天我们一口气来聊聊中华五千年历史

cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 yi4 kou3 qi4 lai2 liao2 liao2 zhong1 hua2 wu3 qian1 nian2 li4 shi3

cues.zh: 开始大约在西元前三千年左右的时候
cues.en: We begin around 3000 BCE.
cues.pinyin: kai1 shi3 da4 yue1 zai4 xi1 yuan2 qian2 san1 qian1 nian2 zuo3 you4 de5 shi2 hou4

cues.zh: 中华大地上的原始部落发展得非常旺盛
cues.en: Tribal communities were flourishing across the land.
cues.pinyin: zhong1 hua2 da4 di4 shang4 de5 yuan2 shi3 bu4 luo4 fa1 zhan3 de2 fei1 chang2 wang4 sheng4

cues.zh: 慢慢的一些比较强的部落就把比较弱的给并吞了
cues.en: Over time, stronger tribes absorbed weaker ones.
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 de5 yi1 xie1 bi3 jiao4 qiang2 de5 bu4 luo4 jiu4 ba3 bi3 jiao4 ruo4 de5 gei3 bing4 tun1 le5

cues.zh: 在中原形成了两个很厉害的部落群
cues.en: Two powerful tribal groups emerged in the Central Plains:
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 yuan2 xing2 cheng2 le5 liang3 ge4 hen3 li4 hai4 de5 bu4 luo4 qun2

cues.zh: 炎帝部落和黄帝部落
cues.en: the tribes of the Yan Emperor and the Yellow Emperor.
cues.pinyin: yan2 di4 bu4 luo4 he2 huang2 di4 bu4 luo4

cues.zh: 这两个部落在阪泉打了一仗
cues.en: The two tribes fought at Banquan.
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 ge4 bu4 luo4 zai4 ban3 quan2 da3 le5 yi1 zhang4

cues.zh: 黄帝打败了炎帝两个部落慢慢融合成华夏族
cues.en: The Yellow Emperor won; the tribes gradually became the Huaxia people.
cues.pinyin: huang2 di4 da3 bai4 le5 yan2 di4 liang3 ge4 bu4 luo4 man4 man4 rong2 he2 cheng2 hua2 xia4 zu2

cues.zh: 炎帝跟黄帝也成了华夏的始祖
cues.en: Both emperors became ancestral figures of the Huaxia.
cues.pinyin: yan2 di4 gen1 huang2 di4 ye3 cheng2 le5 hua2 xia4 de5 shi3 zu3
